value.rationale: The first nontrivial Isaacs flower snark is a canonical 20-vertex cubic non-3-edge-colorable hypohamiltonian graph. Its complete dynamical landscape is a natural benchmark for network majority and reveals a non-implied, meaningful cross-graph reversal: fewer oscillatory orbits but more oscillatory attraction than the same-size dodecahedron, with a sharp 12 versus 7 transient. This is not a narrowly chosen parameter slice or a textbook deduction.
